how do I list devices with ffmpeg

You can list your avfoundation input devices (including microphones) with:

```
ffmpeg -hide_banner -f avfoundation -list_devices true -i ""
```

The output goes to **stderr** (that's normal), and you'll get something like:

```
[AVFoundation input device @ ...]
[AVFoundation input device @ ...] AVFoundation audio devices:
[AVFoundation input device @ ...] [0] MacBook Pro Microphone
[AVFoundation input device @ ...] [1] External Microphone
...
[AVFoundation input device @ ...] AVFoundation video devices:
[AVFoundation input device @ ...] [0] FaceTime HD Camera
```

The `[N]` numbers are what you use after `-i`. So `-i :0` means audio device 0 with no video, `-i 0:1` means video device 0 + audio device 1.
